final: WITH joined AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), channel_avgs AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_rate FROM joined GROUP BY orderbase), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS avg_rate FROM joined), differences AS (SELECT c.avg_rate, c.avg_rate - x.avg_rate AS rate_diff FROM channel_avgs AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS x WHERE c.avg_rate > x.avg_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_rate), AVG(rate_diff) FROM differences
